milestone.title: M211 stale file slug correction + M213 parse_rfc3339_ms dedup — small hygiene batch from herdr-log backlog

intent.outcome: M211's milestone file name matches its spec title, and parse_rfc3339_ms is defined once in a shared autopilot/drive helper module instead of duplicated between cycle.rs and cycle_stale_state_timeout.rs.

problem.description: Two cosmetic-but-real issues logged in mp-herdr-log2.txt session 1+3: (a) M211's milestone file is `211-mp-autopilot-lane-notification-wire-format-shell-command-never-printed-text.json` but its spec title is 'mp autopilot typed task assignment — orchestrator dispatch through herdr argv.' (b) M213's `cycle_stale_state_timeout.rs` duplicates the `parse_rfc3339_ms` function already defined in `cycle.rs`. Both reviewed-and-filed findings landed as 'backlog class' (low severity, no commit), but they're cheap to fix alongside the M230/cleanup pass and removing them reduces reviewer-noise on every autopilot milestone that follows.

in_scope: Rename `master-plan/milestones/211-mp-autopilot-lane-notification-wire-format-shell-command-never-printed-text.json` to a slug matching the current title (`211-mp-autopilot-typed-task-assignment.json`); update any references that point at the old path.

Extract the duplicated `parse_rfc3339_ms` (and any other small RFC3339 parsing helpers already duplicated in autopilot/drive/) into `crates/mp/src/autopilot/drive/time.rs`. Update `cycle_stale_state_timeout.rs` and `cycle.rs` to import from the shared module.
Add a `rg -n 'fn parse_rfc3339_ms'` source-pin that asserts exactly one definition exists.
Re-run the M211 + M213 reviewer scenario tests to confirm no behavior change.
out_of_scope: Touching any spec content (titles, AC verification fields, scope.in_scope items).
Refactoring other RFC3339 helper functions outside `autopilot/drive/`.
Re-doing the M211/M213 review cycles; the rename is hygiene, not a regression.
